mainEntity.name: How should heating and air conditioning be handled in a garage apartment?

acceptedAnswer.text: A garage apartment can be cooled either with a ductless mini-split heat pump or by expanding your existing central air system, but mini-splits are usually the practical choice. Standard home HVAC systems rarely have the spare capacity or duct layout required to condition a separate living space efficiently. A ductless mini-split provides independent temperature controls, operates with high energy efficiency, and requires only a small exterior conduit hole rather than invasive ductwork. Additionally, proper wall and ceiling insulation combined with finished drywall is critical in the Florida heat to prevent the apartment from overheating above unconditioned garage bays.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ductless mini-split heat pumps are the preferred choice, offering independent temperature control and straightforward installation without overburdening central home HVAC systems.
